summary: Greenwood County lookout planned in 1945 with an operator house in 1969-71 and a 1993 phase-out; no source says what remains at the site now.

events.note: Index-Journal reports plans for two towers over 100 feet in Greenwood County; one south-southeast of Hodges on land bought from J.W. Ellison
State commission report: construction started on a residence at Hodges Tower (the report says Berkeley County)
State commission report: a tower residence at the Hodges site completed
Index-Journal (July 13, 1993) says the Hodges tower will be phased out in October; the commission closed its fire tower system on October 1, 1993

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1969-70 report places the Hodges house in Berkeley County. The 1945 and 1993 items on the same page say Greenwood County. Greenwood is treated as correct; the Berkeley reference is probably a transcription or report error.
The 1945 item says the fire protection system was under county control. The state commission's reports from 1969-70 on, and its closure in 1993, place the Hodges tower in the state system.

notes_for_editor: The 1945 item is a plan, not a completion report, and no source I read dates the tower's construction. The 1969-70 Berkeley County placement is the main conflict; checking the original SCFC report would settle it. OpenStreetMap node 357111610 (ele 208, tower:type observation) and TopoQuest id 1242404 match the record; neither is cited. The one search for Hodges returned unrelated results only. Editor check: the 1945 item names one planned tower south-southeast of Hodges and, in a separate paragraph, the land for the tower near Hodges; the story treats these as one tower, and no source says so outright.
